title: Design tab
statement: The system shall provide a Design tab that lists the project's design documents and renders the selected document as Markdown with its realised requirements linked.
rationale: Gives product owners and developers one place in the UI to read how the system is built and which requirements each part realises.

acceptance_criteria.text: The Design tab lists every design document by title, sorted by slug, and shows an empty state with the expected design/ path when there are none
The selected document renders GitHub-flavoured Markdown, including tables and code blocks
Each document shows its realises list, and every REQ-, STORY- or TASK- id in the list or body opens that record in the drawer in 1 click
The Links & impact tab of a requirement lists the design documents that realise it
